_comment: Mutation testing per ADR-020. Scoped to packages/core because that is where a surviving mutant means a wrong score for a real person. Run with `pnpm mutate`.
_pluginsComment: pnpm's isolated node_modules means Stryker cannot auto-discover its plugins; they must be named explicitly or it fails with 'no TestRunner plugins were loaded'.
_thresholdComment: RATCHET, not an aspiration. `break` sits just below the measured score so it can never get WORSE without failing the build. Measured 65.03% on 2026-08-12 (break 64); re-measured 80.42% on 2026-08-13 after the E4 work, so break is now 79. Raise it as survivors fall; NEVER lower it without a HONESTY_LOG entry saying why. ADR-023 E4 requires >=75 overall with no extraction or scoring module below 60 — both now hold, the weakest module being experience.ts at 68.50%.
